name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All nine trials scored exactly 0 on dev, and 0 on training success in the last 10% too, across every seed. Three kinds of change made no difference: recipes (1, 2 or 4 epochs; 74 to 300 updates), heads (footprint pooling, a free conv head, a transposed head, a global MLP head) and per-layer structure. Trials took 30 to 180 s, far below the 900 s limit, so time is not the constraint. Since the networks differ so much and all score 0, I suspect a mismatch in the world rather than slow learning. One candidate is a global spatial misalignment, for example the target shown permuted or shifted relative to the build or the actions. Local convolutions cannot learn that. The flat MLP head could, but it is data-hungry. For this last round I test three ways to mix information globally while keeping weights shared across cells: an MLP-Mixer, a conv network with learned cell-to-cell mixing, and a transformer with learned positions. Any score above 0 would be selected.
